descriptions.text: The genetic variation associated with longer lifespan is associated with reduced risk of COVID-19 infection and hospitalization, and some of the key cells and molecules involved in aging-related CO VID-19 risk are identified.
Demonstrates that genetic variation associated with longer lifespan is linked to reduced COVID-19 risk, identifying key aging-related factors in disease susceptibility.

The genetic variation associated with longer lifespan is associated with reduced risk of COVID-19 infection and hospitalization, and some of the key cells and molecules involved in aging-related COVID-19 risk are identified.

pdfFigures.legendFirstSentence: Mendelian randomization analysis reveals an association of lifespan-related traits with the risk of COVID-19.
Analysis of association of biological age acceleration with the risk of COVID-19.
Bivariate genomic scan identiﬁed Notch signaling as an age-related COVID-19 risk.
Mendelian randomization on 389 immune cell-type-speciﬁc surface markers and analysis of clinical data reveal the role of CD19 in B cells.
